title: Share of teen AI-companion users who felt uncomfortable with something the bot said or did

source.name: Talk, Trust, and Trade-Offs: How and Why Teens Use AI Companions
source.publisher: Common Sense Media (survey fielded by NORC at the University of Chicago)

notes: Among teens who use AI companions, 34% report the bot has said or done something that made them uncomfortable; the remaining 66% report no such incident. (Separately, the same report finds 80% of AI-companion users still say they spend more time with real friends.)

points.label: Felt uncomfortable by something the bot said/did
